text: Docs updated: Practical Isomorphic Git in Macaroni is the whole base-product scope, not a first phase before real git. It means self-written browser-side adapters over existing browser-compatible HTTPS/API transports, riding only as far as square wheels can actually go. No npm isomorphic-git, no dependency, no mandatory backend adapter, no required wrapper, no SSH magic. Smart HTTP/git object subset is optional only for browser-compatible remotes without a sane host API. The Linux transport/spagat joke was preserved in RU/EN research and roadmap docs.
